description: This file contains internal ASN.1 object definitions and function declarations related to PublicKey ASN.1 structures, including various public key types (RSA, DSA, DH) and key pair management functions. It appears to be part of an internal ASN.1 handling library for cryptographic keys, generated by Cisco's ASN.1 code generator.

methods.name: AnscAsn1PublicKeyCreateSelection
methods.description: Creates a selection for a public key based on index.

methods.name: AnscAsn1PublicKeyVerify
methods.description: Verifies a public key signature with given parameters.

methods.name: AnscAsn1RSAPublicKeyCreateChildAttr
methods.description: Creates attribute for RSA public key child element.

methods.name: AnscAsn1RSAPublicKeyVerify
methods.description: Verifies an RSA public key signature.

methods.name: AnscAsn1DSAPublicKeyVerify
methods.description: Verifies a DSA public key signature.

methods.name: AnscAsn1KeyPairCreateChildAttr
methods.description: Creates attribute for a key pair child object.

methods.name: AnscAsn1KeyPairInitKey
methods.description: Initializes a key pair object with specified key type and generator handle.

methods.name: AnscAsn1KeyPairExportKey
methods.description: Exports the key pair to external format.
